title: Optimal Multi-way Decision Trees for Stratified Sampling in Online Controlled Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2609.23308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online controlled experiments, or A/B tests, are widely used to estimate causal effects on digital platforms. A central challenge is to improve experimental sensitivity, or statistical power, without increasing the experimental sample size. Stratified sampling is a classical variance reduction technique; however, its effectiveness depends critically on how the strata are constructed. We thus propose an optimization-based stratification framework for stratified sampling using optimal multi-way decision trees. Our method, called Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees (OMST), formulates stratification as a path-selection problem over a feature graph. The selected paths define interpretable stratification rules and are optimized using an exact variance-minimizing binary optimization formulation under continuous proportional allocation and a Neyman-type optimal allocation. translated_title: 在线受控实验中用于分层抽样的最优多路决策树
translated_abstract: 在线受控实验（即A/B测试）被广泛用于估计数字平台上的因果效应。一个核心挑战是在不增加实验样本量的情况下提高实验的灵敏度（即统计功效）。分层抽样是一种经典的方差缩减技术；然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于分层（层组）的构建方式。因此，我们提出了一种基于优化的分层抽样框架，利用最优多路决策树来实现分层。我们的方法称为最优多路分层树（Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees，OMST），将分层问题建模为特征图上的路径选择问题。所选路径定义了可解释的分层规则，并通过精确的方差最小化二元优化公式进行求解，采用了连续比例分配以及Neyman型最优分配。我们引入有监督的最优分箱技术来生成与结果相关的（此处摘要内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了OMST方法，将分层抽样建模为特征图上的路径选择问题，并通过精确的方差最小化二元优化求解，在不增加样本量的前提下显著提升在线A/B实验的统计功效，同时保持分层规则的可解释性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OMST, which formulates stratification as an interpretable path-selection problem over a feature graph and solves it with an exact variance-minimizing binary optimization, improving the statistical power of online controlled experiments without increasing sample size.
